verses.text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.

verses.text: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.

segments.text: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.

verses.text: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—

segments.text: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—

verses.text: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?

segments.text: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?

verses.text: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.

segments.text: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.

verses.text: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:

segments.text: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:

verses.text: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,

segments.text: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,

verses.text: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.

segments.text: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.

verses.text: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!

segments.text: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
